OUT OF REACH uses two unedited passages ("Ignition sequence start ... We have a liftoff." and
"Tower cleared. We got a roll program."), band-limited to radio quality with a whistle notch and
compression. The line naming the Apollo 11 mission is omitted; AURORA-7 is fictional.
